report.audience: hospitality industry analyst and short-term rental market strategist

brief.title: Global Airbnb Market Comparison: Pricing, Supply & Guest Demand Across 10 Major Cities
brief.one_liner: A comprehensive cross-city analysis of Airbnb listings across New York, London, Paris, Tokyo, Barcelona, Los Angeles, Amsterdam, Bangkok, Rome, and Sydney, examining pricing dynamics, room-type distribution, host concentration, and guest engagement patterns.
brief.goal: Equip the reader with a clear understanding of how Airbnb markets differ across the world's top tourist destinations — identifying which cities command premium pricing, where supply is most concentrated among professional hosts, how room-type mix varies, and where guest demand (as proxied by reviews) is strongest — ultimately enabling data-driven decisions for market entry, investment, or regulatory benchmarking.

required_sections.title: Global Market Overview
required_sections.objective: Summarize the total number of listings per city, overall price distribution, and room-type breakdown to establish the scale and composition of each market.

required_sections.title: Pricing Dynamics Across Cities
required_sections.objective: Compare median and average nightly prices by city and room type, identify the most and least expensive markets, and highlight price dispersion within each city.

required_sections.title: Supply Structure & Host Concentration
required_sections.objective: Analyze the distribution of room types per city, examine the calculated_host_listings_count to assess professional vs. individual host prevalence, and identify cities with the highest host concentration.

required_sections.title: Guest Demand & Review Activity
required_sections.objective: Use number_of_reviews, reviews_per_month, and number_of_reviews_ltm as demand proxies to compare guest engagement across cities and room types, and identify seasonal or recency patterns via last_review dates.

required_sections.title: Availability & Booking Constraints
required_sections.objective: Examine availability_365 and minimum_nights distributions across cities to understand listing accessibility and potential regulatory impacts (e.g., high minimum-night requirements suggesting long-term rental regulations).

required_sections.title: Key Takeaways & Strategic Implications
required_sections.objective: Synthesize findings into actionable insights for investors, hosts, and policymakers, highlighting the most attractive markets and emerging trends.

kpis.name: Median Nightly Price by City
kpis.description: The median value of the 'price' column per city, providing a robust central tendency measure for cross-market comparison.

kpis.name: Professional Host Share
kpis.description: Percentage of listings in each city where calculated_host_listings_count >= 5, indicating the share of supply controlled by multi-listing (professional) hosts.

kpis.name: Average Reviews per Month
kpis.description: Mean of reviews_per_month by city, serving as a proxy for booking frequency and guest demand intensity.

kpis.name: Mean Availability (days/year)
kpis.description: Average availability_365 per city, indicating how much of the year listings are open for booking — a signal of commercial intent and regulatory environment.

kpis.name: Entire Home Share
kpis.description: Percentage of listings classified as 'Entire home/apt' per city, reflecting the commercialization level of each market.
